acceptanceCriteria: Document all six HTTP error codes with accurate existing source semantics without changing production behavior.
Retain passing error-code-ownership-check, relevant documentation verification and exact updated PR evidence; do not claim original full GH399 qualification complete.
body:
Confirmed on PR #418 head ba5cefc5a59f95fdde6854170e588eaca1638786 (Core installed build163; Tasks developer build202). Hosted CI run36837842026 job110289481087 fails make error-code-ownership-check. The owning documentation-corpus-v1.md omits concurrency-bound, invalid-query, json-required, query-refused, read-query-post-required and unknown-operation emitted by internal/corpusserve/http.go:27-60. Expected: the owning spec names every emitted code with source-accurate rejection semantics. Actual: six uncatalogued codes fail hosted doc-gates even though the selected native focused-docs gate passes because it omits this check. Raw and normalized failure logs are retained at /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/corpus89-hosted-doc-gates.raw.log and corpus89-hosted-doc-gates.log. Bounded documentation repair is already assigned under live owning attempt89/V1-0551; this record is observed defect memory, not a competing implementation claim. Searches for error-code ownership, ownership and corpus HTTP found no equivalent; V1-0525 covers different ten codes/four different specs.

Repair evidence (2026-10-01): two-path documentation update cec4b5a7c8bb5e4a6fbbab437a5b7a33fd4a9dff, independent review PASS, frozen error-code/docs and spec-index checks plus strict completion PASS at 4aad8266cb49c82b8cbb7b9ad787b4413b1ab979. Seal d99b49cf60ca570a36f18346d3a0fc11fff44e94 published to ready PR #418. Native attempt89 submit1601 and focused-docs gate1602 passed exact clean tree1476664d1978cdeab6b4298f30f5f51c6a677cac. No Go production or test files changed. Original hosted failure retained; updated hosted CI and integration are pending. Ticket remains OPEN. Handoff /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/corpus90-final-handoff.json, 58 artifact hashes verified by coordinator.
title: Corpus HTTP companion omits six emitted error codes from its owning spec
